div.head: Hn 59.16a
div.ab: Et non fiat bellum sine capitali ad minus X sol., nisi de furto uel huiusmodi nequicia compellacio sit uel de pace regis infracta uel in illis in quibus est capitale mortis uel diffactionis.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 579 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Beginn der Einschränkung des Zweikampfbeweises (Pollock and Maitland HEL. II 630); vgl. Ludwig VII 1168: pro debito citra 5 sol. inter aliquos non iudicetur duellum; über Mindestwerth für kampffähige Klage in anderen Rechten s. Brunner DRG. II 418<sup>111</sup>

Beginning of the restriction of proof by battle (Pollock and Maitland HEL. II 630); cf. Louis VII 1168: pro debito citra 5 sol. inter aliquos non iudicetur duellum; on a minimum value for a claim admitting of battle in other laws see Brunner DRG. II 418<sup>111</sup>
